ov: الساموراي الأخير (الإنجليزية: The Last Samurai) هو فلم أمريكي ملحمي دارمي أخرجه وشارك في إنتاجه إدوارد زويك الذي ساهم أيضاً في كتابة السيناريو والحوار مع جون لوغان من إنتاج شركة وارنر بروس. جسد بطولة الفيلم كل من توم كروز - الذي ساهم في إنتاجه - وكين وتنابي وشين كويامادا وتوني غولدواين وهورويوكي سانادا وتيموثي سبال وبيل كونولي. أتت فكرة الفيلم من مشروع لفينسينت وارد الذي شد انتباه إدوارد زويك فقرر فينسينت أن يكون المنتج المنفذ وحيل إخراجه والقيام عليه للإدوارد زويك. تم تصوير بعض مشاهد الفيلم في البلاد النيوزلاندية.
plotEn:
In 1876, former U.S. Army Captain Nathan Algren, an alcoholic traumatized by his actions during the American Indian Wars, is asked by his former commanding officer, Colonel Bagley, to train the newly created Imperial Japanese Army. A Japanese businessman, Matsue Omura, intends to use the army to suppress a samurai rebellion against Japan's new emperor. Despite his hatred of Bagley, Algren accepts and his old friend, Sergeant Zebulon Gant, accompanies him. 
In Japan, Algren meets Simon Graham, a British translator knowledgeable about the samurai. Algren finds the Imperial conscripts lacking in discipline and difficult to train. Omura and Bagley learn of a rebel assault on one of Omura's railroads and Algren is forced to lead a counterattack of half-trained, inexperiencd recruits. The terrified conscripts flee and are easily routed by the samurai. Gant is killed in the battle and the wounded Algren is taken prisoner. Samurai leader Moritsugu Katsumoto spares his life and Imperial General Hasegawa, a former samurai who once served with Katsumoto, is allowed to commit seppuku.
Katsumoto takes Algren to his village and requests Taka, his sister, care for the wounded American. Algren realizes she is the widow of Hirotaro, a samurai he killed in the battle. With Taka's help, Algren overcomes his alcoholism and guilt, learns the Japanese culture, earns the respect of the samurai and is trained in the art of kenjutsu.
